description: Confirmatory experiment protocol for the ExtStats Advisor paper. This file freezes required evidence and comparison semantics; the system-under-test is frozen by system-freeze-v1 while research-harness provenance is recorded per artifact.

postgresql_identity_source.rule: Use the built role identity as the source of exact PostgreSQL source/version/configuration/build provenance; do not infer final paper pins from a floating version string.

system_under_test.scope: advisor, patched PostgreSQL, stock PostgreSQL, and their build contracts

freeze_gate.rule: Use system-freeze-v1 for the frozen SUT and record the actual committed research harness SHA in every experiment artifact; do not substitute a floating PostgreSQL version or a global research SHA.

seed_policy.semantic_rule: The seed identifier and the PostgreSQL floating-point setseed argument are distinct protocol fields. Integer-division spelling is forbidden.

datasets.production_exact_role: independent Census13 equivalence validation and production truth-acquisition cost path
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection
independent validation/cost path only; no repeated benchmark truth recollection

ground_truth_input.role: Evaluate planner estimates and define utility; never construct native statistics and never alter the PostgreSQL estimator.

source_kinds.collection: Exact counts in a read-only repeatable-read source view.
source_kinds.constraints: Only the supported sealed postgresql-simple-selection-v2 workload contract; exact collection can be expensive.

source_kinds.collection: Import and validate externally produced exact labels with provenance and snapshot/workload binding.
source_kinds.constraints: The advisor must not claim to have executed externally supplied labels.

confirmatory_arecel_policy.rule: Every fresh AdvisorSnapshot imports the observations into a new GroundTruthSet; a GroundTruthSet from another snapshot is never reused.
confirmatory_arecel_policy.production_exact_role: Independent validation mechanism and measured production exact-count cost path, not the default repeated benchmark truth acquisition.

metrics_and_objectives.optimization_objective: sum(weight_q * Q_q) / sum(weight_q) over positive-weight workload queries
metrics_and_objectives.uniform_weight_rule: If a confirmatory workload has weight one for every query, arithmetic mean and the optimization objective coincide numerically but remain distinct contracts.

required_baseline_configurations.role: RQ1 stock baseline and deployment target
required_baseline_configurations.postgresql_build_identity: paper/system-freeze-v1.json:stock_postgresql.required_build_contract plus the per-run postgres-lab identity digest

required_baseline_configurations.dataset_variation_rule: Preserve any audited dataset-specific baseline difference and record it in the manifest. Current four paper-baseline manifests record target 10000; Census13 records the target at baseline level.

fixed_k_quality.k_policy: Pre-register k independently of the final advisor recommendation.
fixed_k_quality.ground_truth_policy: Heuristic selection cannot use GroundTruthSet; utility-based methods use the same bound GroundTruthSet after selection as declared by RQ4.
fixed_k_quality.budget_policy: Declare and report a maximum planner-evaluation budget and actual evaluations for every method.

fixed_evaluation_budget.budget_policy: Pre-register common planner-evaluation and wall-clock caps.
fixed_evaluation_budget.information_policy: Do not convert unused budget into extra information for another method; infeasible variants are censored.

experiments.configuration_scope_note: The matched RQ1 artifact is the fixed three-arm comparison (stock default, stock target10000, and advisor). workload-frequency-top-k, dependency-correlation-top-k, singleton-utility-top-k, random-k, greedy ADD, and exhaustive tiny-universe comparisons belong to RQ4 and are not complete merely because the RQ1 dataset campaign advances.

canary_protocol.historical_artifact_role: The existing Census13 canary is retained as the immutable planner-execution source; its production-exact GroundTruthSet is one-time equivalence evidence, while the canonical derived result imports audited AreCEL observations.
canary_protocol.budget_selection_basis: Pre-existing experiments/arecel-census13/search-budget-k8/calibration-v1.json: 60 and 120 seconds expired incomplete rounds; 180 seconds was the first local-optimum completion. This value is frozen before the canary and is not outcome-tuned.
canary_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; never the patched sandbox objective

forest10_confirmatory_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; sandbox objective is separate

power7_confirmatory_protocol.headline_evaluation: stock PostgreSQL full-data deployment; sandbox objective is separate
power7_confirmatory_protocol.in_workload_scope: The RQ1 workload is the workload used by the advisor objective; this result does not establish held-out query generalization.

cross_dataset_summary.revision_reason: Strictly separate observations, snapshot-bound GroundTruthSet, historical production-exact truth, and Census13 equivalence-bound external truth provenance. Estimates and metrics are unchanged.

experiments.truth_contract: truth_contracts.ground_truth_input; confirmatory source is the dataset-gated audited AreCEL observations policy
experiments.random_seed_policy: Use dataset adapter and baseline manifest seeds; record experiment seed identifier and exact PostgreSQL setseed SQL.
completion_criteria: all source identities resolved
matched per-dataset manifests validated
raw and derived artifacts content-addressed

protocol: P1 add-only Recommendation plus final ANALYZE
P2 research-only advisor-object removal without ANALYZE followed by rollback
experiments.truth_contract: truth_contracts.ground_truth_input; confirmatory source is the dataset-gated audited AreCEL observations policy
experiments.random_seed_policy: Reuse the frozen dataset/sample protocol and record all seeds in the RunManifest.
completion_criteria: P1/P2 ordinary-statistics contract verified
advisor-managed object identity verified
rollback evidence present

experiments.truth_contract: One freshly bound GroundTruthSet per snapshot, imported from the dataset-gated audited AreCEL observations policy.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Freeze sample seed, workload order, and all search seeds in the manifest.
completion_criteria: both utilities use the declared loss/weight contracts
no RQ3 mechanism claim is inferred from this relationship

experiments.comparison: Physical native statistics versus catalogless hypothetical overlay on the same patched PostgreSQL binary.
experiments.main_factor: physical catalog realization versus hypothetical overlay realization
controls: identical payload bytes where technically possible
derived_metrics: q-error correlation as secondary diagnostic only
experiments.truth_contract: GroundTruthSet is not required to establish mechanism fidelity; if utility is reported, bind audited observations separately to each snapshot and do not make it the primary fidelity metric.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Record all data/sample/statistics seeds; no unrecorded randomization in paired configurations.

artifact_contract.primary_metric: direct exact root Plan Rows agreement
artifact_contract.status_semantics: A runner result is artifact-created with fidelity_gate pass/fail. Paper status becomes ready-to-run only after a live exact gate; no artifact is complete by itself.

experiments.implementation_status: The three-configuration synthetic runner and rq3-fidelity-v1 cross-field validator are implemented and unit-validated. The small live gate passed on the pinned patched PostgreSQL build; no benchmark result is complete.

implementation_gate.scope: small synthetic live gate; readiness evidence only, not a completed confirmatory result

completion_criteria: same patched binary verified for both primary arms
physical and overlay states independently verified
no binary/build substitution used to claim primary fidelity

experiments.comparison: Patched PostgreSQL physical statistics versus stock PostgreSQL physical statistics with hypothetical overlay inactive.
experiments.role: Secondary ordinary physical-statistics sanity check; never the primary hypothetical-fidelity result.

artifact_contract.pass_rule: Only exact paired Plan Rows matches with equivalent state/payload/settings controls pass.
artifact_contract.fail_rule: A Plan Rows mismatch is fail only after every control is satisfied.
artifact_contract.inconclusive_rule: Any data, ordinary-statistics, payload, planner-setting, or overlay-state mismatch is inconclusive.

implementation_gate.scope: small synthetic readiness evidence; secondary sanity only, not a completed confirmatory result

experiments.implementation_status: The independent patched-versus-stock physical sanity runner produced a passing small synthetic readiness artifact. This does not complete the confirmatory RQ3 experiment.
completion_criteria: overlay inactive verified
stock and patched physical setup independently verified
result labeled secondary sanity only

primary_eligible_universe.conditional_screened_universe: A utility/outcome-screened universe, if used, is a separately labeled conditional diagnostic and cannot replace the primary universe.

experiments.ground_truth_policy: Only utility-based methods use GroundTruthSet during selection; every selected result is evaluated against the same bound truth.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Pre-register replicate seeds; record them and break non-random ties by candidate ID after declared score/static precedence.
experiments.deployment_policy: Every method uses the same canonical evaluation/deployment ordering and records membership, evaluation order, deployment order, and physical identities.
experiments.independent_evaluation: Stock PostgreSQL full-data physical estimates with the same authoritative truth; sandbox objective is separate.

synthetic_validation_artifact.gate: six eligible candidates, k=3 exhaustive enumeration of 20 subsets, deterministic ordering/ties, replayable greedy trace

completion_criteria: k is pre-registered independently of final advisor recommendation
planner evaluation counts are reported for all methods

budget.censoring_rule: Record budget-expired/infeasible methods and preserve the incomplete trace; never grant a larger budget silently.

experiments.primary_eligible_universe: The same primary universe as rq4-fixed-k-ablations; eligibility cannot use utility or outcome signals.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Pre-register replicate seeds and record actual planner evaluations and wall time.
experiments.independent_evaluation: Stock PostgreSQL full-data physical estimates with the same authoritative truth; sandbox objective is separate.
completion_criteria: no method receives a silently larger budget
infeasible exhaustive variants are labeled censored

experiments.truth_cost_rule: Report external import/validation separately from production exact count collection; neither is a proxy for the other.
experiments.random_seed_policy: Use the corresponding frozen run seed policy and record environment/measurement repetitions.
completion_criteria: all measured stages have provenance
no zero-online-overhead claim is substituted for measured costs

entries.note: The four-dataset, three-arm, in-workload matched comparison is complete with the immutable cross-dataset summary. This does not complete RQ4 heuristic ablations or establish held-out query generalization.
Existing baseline artifacts are preliminary and require confirmatory provenance audit.
Calibration artifacts are supporting diagnostics, not completed ablations.
The rq4-ablation-v1 synthetic gate passed with independent fixed k=4 policy and a six-candidate tiny-universe exhaustive validation. No formal AreCEL result is complete.
The harness records common 2,000-evaluation/300-second caps and censoring. No formal AreCEL result is complete.
Small live synthetic gate passed on the pinned patched build: 3 configurations, 9 exact Plan Rows pairs, zero mismatches, cleanup verified; confirmatory paper execution remains outstanding.
Small synthetic artifact passed: three configurations, 9 exact Plan Rows pairs, payload and ordinary-statistics correspondence verified, overlay inactive, cleanup verified; readiness evidence only.

execution_priorities.name: protocol/source freeze and RQ3 mechanism-fidelity harness
RQ1 matched baselines and RQ4 inexpensive heuristic baselines
RQ2 confirmatory transfer and sample/full utility analysis
RQ5 cost accounting and sensitivity analyses

global_completion_criteria: All required source identities are resolved in the paper-experiment manifest.
The research tree is clean before every canonical run.
Each raw artifact is versioned or content-addressed and bound to a RunManifest.
Each derived artifact records source artifact digests and system identities.
Expected paper figures/tables are reproducible from declared derived artifacts.
Pilot/preliminary evidence is never silently relabeled complete.
Superseded results remain referenced with status superseded rather than overwritten.
